fonts.display: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Inkstone
palette.role: Primary text, body copy, headings, hairline borders, dark UI surfaces — the near-black backbone of the entire interface, used at massive scale for borders and typography

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas, section backgrounds, subtle surface tier beneath cards — a warm off-white that softens the contrast of the interface

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Card surfaces, elevated panels, chat widget container, inputs — the brightest tier of the surface stack

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Decorative SVG fills, disabled input borders, neutral dividers

palette.name: Plum Ash
palette.role: Muted card borders and dark surface tints — a desaturated plum that appears on secondary containers

palette.name: Forest Depth
palette.role: Primary brand identity, filled dark buttons, dark accent bar on stat cards, announcement bar background — deep green that signals authority and trust without corporate blandness

palette.name: Periwinkle
palette.role: Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Candy Pink
palette.role: Accent bar on stat cards, decorative soft surface washes — the most playful of the four accents, used sparingly to add warmth

palette.name: Butter
palette.role: Accent bar on stat cards, warmth punctuation — the warmest accent, appearing only on the 4th stat card as a visual rhythm closer
